changelog-writer.base: Update CHANGELOG.md from the commits merged since the last tag, grouped into Added, Changed, Fixed and Removed. Use when preparing a release or when asked to bring the changelog up to date.
changelog-writer.clause: Don't use for user-facing announcements of a release (release-notes) or writing a single commit message (commit-message).

commit-message.base: Draft a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff: type, optional scope, imperative summary under 72 characters, and a body that explains why. Use when the user asks for a commit message.
commit-message.clause: Don't use for summarising a whole release (changelog-writer).

markdown-tables.base: Align, sort and repair Markdown pipe tables, keeping cell content intact. Use whenever a Markdown table is malformed or hard to read.
markdown-tables.clause: Don't use for reviewing SQL that produced the table (sql-review) or changelog tables (changelog-writer).

release-notes.base: Write user-facing release notes for a tagged version: what changed for the reader, upgrade steps and known issues, in plain language. Use when a release is being announced.
release-notes.clause: Don't use for updating CHANGELOG.md itself (changelog-writer).

sql-review.base: Review SQL migrations before they run: table locks, missing indexes on new foreign keys, unsafe column type changes and irreversible steps. Use on any new or changed migration file.
sql-review.clause: Don't use for formatting query results as tables; that is markdown-tables.
